scope: 24 original complete-site templates (separate from 157 showroom components)
rightsPolicy: Every remote asset remains unapproved pending verified source/creator/license/depictee-property rights and validated local derivatives. Matching component stock references does NOT confer approval.

pilotVisualReview.notes: Poster depicts a person in flowing green studio fashion clothing with a green backdrop, visible white tracking crosses, and white geometric platforms. The 3:5 portrait crop keeps the subject and platforms while trimming outer set pieces. Need actual OFFCUT title contrast/crop acceptance on phone; source photographer, depicted-person release and commercial redistribution remain unverified.
Retail interior shows visible U.S. Navy branding; person/property/brand use context remains unverified. Phone crops retain displays, but not approved.
Banana still-life is truncated by phone center and attention cover crops; full-frame contain with matching background is a safer preliminary candidate.
Photo shows person with sunglasses/shopping bags. Attention phone crop nearly excludes the person; center composition retains their upper body. Model/brand rights unverified.
Branded outdoor gear flat lay on wooden boards over a map. Narrow cover crop cuts peripheral boots and pack; not a photographed Route Kit. Replace with brand-neutral relevant navigation kit.

White performance coupe parked in a dim multi-car indoor storage area, not a silver sports car. Centered 3:5 phone cover clips much of the foreground vehicle; attention crop retains its front but loses setting.
Lamp against green wall; original alt claiming desk objects was inaccurate and corrected. Attention phone crop better retains lamp; rights still unverified.
Orange-lit conical tent in dark woods. Center phone crop keeps tent; source does not demonstrate fictional two-person storm shelter, pitching claims or ownership.
Person in floral summer dress near coast; phone cover crops lose much of wider composition. A replacement may be preferable if face-forward portrait required; model rights unverified.

Beachfront homes on supports above a sandy coastal shore with visible surf, not a verified Georgian Bay waterfront residence and not the photo used for the 'Drift House' hero. Narrow phone crops focus on the elevated decks; 16:9 stress crop loses much of the upper architecture.
Man in dark sweater against black; 16:9 desktop crop cuts his face. Vertical phone framing preserves portrait better.
Person in yellow outfit on basketball court; 16:9 wide crop removes head and legs. Phone vertical preserves scene.
Woman in dark clothing against charcoal studio backdrop; old natural-light alt inaccurate. Wide crop cuts face; opening-left 3:4 desktop and 3:5 phone need CSS review.
Person in sunglasses, red lettered shirt and jacket under blue sky; 16:9 wide crop cuts eyewear/face. Opening-right 5:4 desktop and 3:4 phone need review; garment logo/lettering rights unresolved.
Woman in patterned jacket and white collar against rust red wall; phone attention crop shifts face toward edge; centered crop initially preferable. Old generic alt clarified.
Blue-lit portrait against lilac background, not dark blurred as previously described. Both image alts corrected. Feature and gallery placements need separate fit review.

Rear view of a person with hair tied up, white athletic top and dark leggings, gripping a loaded barbell at head/overhead level inside a black metal squat/press rack against a grey brick wall. ROGUE logo visible on rack; clothing also has visible insignia. Not evidence of YARD facility, staff, equipment sponsorship or membership. 16:9 wide crop retains subject and bar but clips more of torso/equipment ends; narrow 3:5 phone crop may trim the plate/bar ends and centralize person.
Bright blue performance coupe parked outdoors on desert ground at sunset, not a red vehicle or post-detailing job. Narrow centered 3:5 crops cut away much of the vehicle.

Silver-gray BMW performance sedan parked on a road at dusk with hills behind, not a close-up of freshly detailed bodywork. Portrait crops keep the car; trade dress and client context remain unverified.

Small white hut on a snow-covered frozen lake in bright low winter light; not a photograph of the advertised Lake Suite or verifiably a Muskoka rental. Wide crop retains hut; narrow 3:4 crops cut some shoreline but remain readable. Replace suite image before publication.

Sunlit contemporary living room with upholstered armchairs, leather sofa, indoor plants, tall windows and grid of framed art. Tall phone crop cuts edge of sofa, but keeps wall gallery. No verified studio commission or location.
Geometric contemporary house EXTERIOR from driveway, clad in timber and pale stone/concrete surfaces. Original alt falsely described an interior. Narrow 3:5 phone crop removes building wings.
Dusk view of broad glazed angular residence with glowing interior behind a large foreground tree. Original hero alt underdescribed low-light setting. Tall mobile crop loses parts of building facade.

White two-storey geometric modern house beside clear blue pool with broad glazing, wood soffit and midday sky. Ontario project location and designer unknown; phone crop loses the right-hand structure.
Metal kettle on a compact stove with a mug in front of turquoise tent. Portrait crop retains camping scene, but does not depict a confirmed RANGE/FOUND enamel cup.
Green hiking pack on rocky ground beside flowing water. Portrait crops preserve pack; image cannot substantiate invented waxed ripstop or aluminium frame claims.
Hiker with large pack in evergreen forest, not a visible glacier or mountain landscape. Corrected unsupported hero location caption. Review focal point behind mobile headline.

A hand pours glossy dark chocolate sauce over a small round pale dessert on a clear glass cake stand. A plainly visible Nutella-branded jar stands in the background; this is not a one- or two-tier wedding cake, nor demonstrated bakery work. Wide 16:9 crop cuts tabletop/stand context; phone tall preserves the jar and pouring hand, but risks implied endorsement of Nutella.

Close, over-the-shoulder view of a black-clad tattoo artist with dark hair wearing black gloves and using a dark wrapped tattoo machine against a client's already tattooed skin; some purple stencil marks visible at the right edge. The precise anatomical location cannot be determined from the photograph; original alt 'client's arm' unsupported. The device carries small visible product markings. The image cannot substantiate any BLACKLINE artwork, studio, equipment standards, identity or working relationship. Wide crop isolates machine, gloved hands and ink; tall phone crop retains some artist silhouette.

Small cabin on vivid turquoise lake with steep pine-covered mountains behind; an alpine scene that does not credibly depict the claimed Lake Rosseau/Muskoka house. Wide crop loses mountain context, portrait retains it. Replace as featured property photograph.
Hiker wearing orange padded jacket touching a summit marker; 4:5 phone view preserves figure. Cannot establish the fictional product specifications; model and brand concerns open.

Person wearing a cap and gloves machine-polishing a black vehicle panel near the side mirror. A 16:9 stress crop excludes the worker's face; tall portrait shows person and panel. Model and workplace rights remain unverified.

Bright white sink, steel faucet, round wall mirror, three transparent cotton/accessory containers on a wooden tray and a black pump bottle with visible other-brand lettering. Not a MORA bathroom install or verified MORA Sink Set. Portrait crop cuts right-hand black bottle and part of mirror; bath props should not imply a real kit for sale.

Portrait garden scene with broad vivid green foliage in foreground, low pink/white flowers, stone paving and steps, a dark raised horizontal railing or structure and dense trees beyond. Does not identify a constructed patio or BED & BORDER property. 16:9 stress crop cuts most stone steps and flower beds in favour of big foreground leaves; narrow phone crop preserves tall garden but not complete site.

Interior bedroom with exposed timber beams and stone fireplace; broad visual description matches. 3:4 portrait cover trims the bed and fireplace edge; need real CSS room-card crop check. No evidence the depicted room exists at a fictional retreat.

Pastel sugar cookies shaped as white unicorn heads, pink number fours and round initial-L medallions displayed on a white cake stand. Generic cookie offering is visually aligned but no evidence this bakery made them or that pricing/minimum order matches. Wide 16:9 crop loses the outer stand and some cookies; tall crop preserves most examples.

Three pale skincare products on a stone plinth amid dried plants; the bottle labels visibly read ENDLESS PURE and include small printed product claims. MORA's hero presents a separate imaginary four-piece Daily Set with sample pricing; the photo is neither that kit nor MORA-branded. Tall crop captures all three containers but trims floral/stone context.
Dark cooking pot on a small gas canister by a stone wall. Wide 16:9 stress crop truncates fuel canister; portrait view is closer to intended 4:5 product card.

A visibly tattooed bearded adult wearing glasses and a backwards grey cap tattoos the arm of a seated person with extensive existing ink. Black gloves, green-wrapped tattoo machine, a bright circular lamp, partial orange lettering and several background people are visible. Scene resembles a busy public tattoo setting but precise event/location and artist identity are unverified. Wide crop cuts upper lamp and parts of seated client's body; phone crops preserve artist and client's arm but cannot establish ownership of the tattoo artwork.

Modern waterfront house with orange roof/trim accents, timber/stone cladding, landscaping and a small dock visible. The photo is not known to show the fictional Drift House or Thornbury. The landscape original is reasonably framed in 16:9; narrow phone crops remove some shore and building facade.

Vertical dark-stained tiered wooden planter troughs against masonry block wall, with dry plants. No evidence for cedar species, hidden liner, actual maker or dimensions. 16:9 wide crops lose most tiers; tall portrait retains the subject.

The North Face-marked stuff sack and Hydro Flask-marked bottle beside orange fabric. Does not depict a repair roll; replace rather than imply the pictured branded products are fictional RANGE/FOUND goods.

Black-and-white music venue view across audience silhouettes toward an unoccupied-looking stage with drum kit, microphones and spotlights; no performing band clearly visible. Hero/venue usage would falsely locate it at fictional harbour warehouse. Portrait phone crops lose some stage equipment and crowd context.

Dark plum and black paneled wall with a tall thin shaded lamp; a corner of a set table, drinking glass and folded linen appear near the lower edge. Existing lamp/table description is broadly consistent, though visible glass is not confirmed as wine. Stock photo cannot document SERA or its claimed seat count, layout or location. Wide crop reduces the already-limited lower table context; tall phone retains wall and lamp.

Barefoot person in hat and green trousers operating a powered circular saw while crouched beside timber at a workshop bench. Unsafe professional-workshop example, urgent replacement required. Person and context not linked to fictional studio; portrait crop highlights saw and bare feet.

Vertical crowd-and-stage photograph with saturated red lights, a lit stage backdrop and illuminated script-like signage near the top. Branding/location and depicted performance are not linked to the fictitious AFTER DARK lineup. Wide crop cuts much of venue crowd/vertical setting; phone crop resembles full portrait but excludes surrounding stage edges.

Autumn scene showing leafless tree in front of a raised grey stone-paved terrace with short broad angular steps, a backdrop of dark hedge, yellow and orange foliage, and low shrubs. Photo is not evidence of mature maple retention, improved drainage, new materials, construction design, a precise Ontario address, or a finished project by BED & BORDER. Wide crop loses most terrace steps and ground plane; tall crop preserves tree and overall terrace context.

Close-up of a stacked rectangular pale grey masonry retaining/garden wall with coping stones. A few small plants at its base and soft blurred flowers or shrubs behind. Not evidence it is the detailed stonework of TM-050's terrace or a BED & BORDER installation. Tall crop discards much of the left/right stone coursing and wall context.

Wide-angle photograph of enormous indoor arena concert with extended runway, pyro flame jets, smoke and audience throughout large stands; a clear mismatch to small two-room harbour warehouse and the invented MAIN ROOM 00:42 caption. Tall phone stress crop cuts grandstand scale and side stage.

Person in a wide-brim hat working timber with a hand tool at a dim workshop bench. Existing 36-inch white oak shelf caption not established. 16:9 crop cuts person's lower body and wider shop; portrait retains process context.

Two narrow wall-mounted white display ledges holding framed artwork and wood cutting boards. Does not prove species, front-rail design, exact sizes or studio commission. Wide crop clips high shelf; tall portrait shows both.

Elevated view of enormous dense outdoor music crowd toward brightly lit stage and advertising signage. Not a SIDE ROOM 01:17 shot or proof of this event; vertical crops discard much of crowd width. Venue and identity/trademark evidence unverified.

Dark living area silhouettes furniture in front of large windows overlooking water and vivid sunset clouds. This supports a lake-view interior photo description, but not the fictional Tiny Township listing, bed count or shoreline footage. Portrait crop keeps the central water view and loses side furnishings.

Dim furnished dining interior with wood-topped round tables laid with cutlery, glassware and napkins, dark chairs, and a large semicircular arched window in the background. Description of an arched-window restaurant is supported; fictional SERA ownership, service, neighborhood and room dimensions are not. Wide crop mostly shows foreground table setting and loses the arch; tall crop keeps window/table relationship.

An extreme macro of pale yellow-to-cream frosting or whipped topping in piped swirls with orange-coloured bits/shavings. Does not show an entire cake or verify a vanilla bean raspberry layer, cake dimension, buttercream recipe, edible ingredients or wedding/celebration inventory. Wide crop still macro; tall crop limits context further.

Wood-paneled room with bed and orange freestanding wood stove, not a masonry fireplace; corrected inaccurate alt text. Portrait crop keeps stove and partial bed. Forest-view and property identity remain unverified.

Unfurnished concrete room with full-height glazing overlooking a valley, broad water and prominent mountain peaks. Mountain scenery contradicts the implied Georgian Bay setting; should be replaced with appropriate setting before commercial use. Centered 3:5 phone crop preserves most glazing but loses outer edges and adjacent context.

Opulent interior with many bright golden orb/pendant lights, curved tan upholstered banquette or booth seating, round set tables and lush center greenery. Existing hero alt incorrectly emphasized dark wood tables rather than the bright golden pendants and upholstery. Photo is not evidence of SERA's imaginary open kitchen, 38 seats or Queen West setting; wide crop removes portions of room ceiling and floor.

Architectural pool or water feature beside a long tan-panelled modern building, a vertical dark line along the wall, metal handrails at the far edge, and dark trees. The water occupies the foreground and is bordered by pale coping. Not recognizably a residential Oakville pool; cannot confirm pool dimensions, structure, concrete, limestone, flush coping, dark tile, shallow steps, construction firm or occupancy. Landscape wide crop reduces the height of tan wall and water-plane, phone tall preserves perspective.
Blue-grey HOKA-branded high-top trail footwear with Vibram marking on bare ground under open sky. Not leather rebuildable Ridge Boot; replace before commercial presentation.

Blue water occupies foreground, visually meeting a distant view near a low horizon; palm trees, lush tropical vegetation and modern white buildings under broad blue sky. Appears visually consistent with vanishing-edge effect, but overflow channels, catch basin, pool engineering, property rights, exact locale and connection to TIDEFORM are not shown. Wide crop discards much sky and top framing; phone tall preserves horizon and landscaping.

Square warm interior photo: three red/burgundy skincare containers with legible branding staged on a white plinth bearing NORDIC in uppercase, above dark brown tiled display; overhead hanging pendant lamp and a plant. Clearly not MORA products and not evidence of its refills, sustainable packaging or manufacturing. Desktop wide crop loses much pendant lamp while retaining brand display; tall crop trims lateral plant context.

Indoor gym with a muscular adult with dark tied-back hair, a navy/black graphic tank and dark shorts leaning forward with both hands resting on/gripping the handles of two large kettlebells on the floor. Not walking or carrying the weights, despite original alt text. Gym equipment and a wall-mounted heater or unit are visible behind. Landscape 16:9 crop cuts off athlete's head and lower kettlebell detail. Neither athlete nor location is verified as YARD staff/client.

Small rectangular outdoor courtyard swimming pool with dark blue water bordered by pale paving and bright green lawn, between white modern buildings with large glazed openings and flat projecting roofline. This is the hero background, not proof of the proposed custom concrete pool, any 3 ft 6 in to 7 ft depth, construction permit, installed equipment, pool safety or client site. Phone tall crops much of the wings and lawn; wide crop retains full architecture.

Warm sunset over a calm lake, low dock extending from one shore, foreground leaves at left. Crop options retain sunset and dock with different foreground balance; real text-over-image contrast and exact phone hero focal point require browser QA. Lake/location not verified as Rosseau.

pilotVideoReview.notes: HEAD succeeded but did not return Content-Length. Playback frames, duration, codec, exact file size, creator and depicted-person releases were not inspected. The optional remote video is now opt-in, preload none and has no source URL assigned until click. A 1080p-or-smaller rights-cleared rendition is still required before production.
